descriptor.name: Jundiaí public cadastral parcel polygons
descriptor.scope: Public cadastral parcel geometry around the unchanged Jundiaí WUP settlement locator. Thirteen aligned cells and 205 unique full parcels passed stable counts, complete paging, fresh native-ID geometry reads, correctly shaped explicit absence and full-parcel one-parcel binding. Root independent EPSG:31983 GEOS audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The exact unchanged WUP locator has no parcel hit in its containing cell; nearby public parcel BR-JUNDIAI-LOTES-JUND-GID-46298 supports complete one-parcel binding. Native gid identifies individual GIS ground polygons; the duplicate codlote business reference is not used as runtime identity. Evidence is bounded and does not establish citywide or nationwide completeness, survey precision, legal ownership or currentness.
descriptor.attribution: Município de Jundiaí / GeoJundiaí · cadastral references · adapted
descriptor.licenceNote: Publisher conditions, legal effect and update schedule are informational. Public native parcel IDs and geometry only; ownership is not imported.
